trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%mg%' OR text ILIKE '%areal%' OR text ILIKE '%loading%' OR text ILIKE '%cm2%' OR text ILIKE '%cm^2%' OR text ILIKE '%cm−2%' OR text ILIKE '%mg/cm%' ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT id, kind, page, left(text,200) FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%areal%' OR text ILIKE '%mg/cm%' OR text ILIKE '%mg cm%' OR text ILIKE '%mg·cm%' OR text ILIKE '%cm−2%' OR text ILIKE '%cm-2%' OR text ILIKE '%cm^−2%' OR text ILIKE '%cm2%'

SELECT 'ocr' k, id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%mg%' OR text ILIKE '%cm%' OR text ILIKE '%load%' UNION ALL SELECT 'fact', id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%mg%' OR statement ILIKE '%load%' UNION ALL SELECT 'line', id, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%mg%' OR text ILIKE '%cm2%' OR text ILIKE '%cm^2%' OR text ILIKE '%cm 2%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (5,6) AND (text ILIKE '%sulfur%' OR text ILIKE '%electrode%' OR text ILIKE '%cathode%') ORDER BY page, line_no
